highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 updates the bundled renderer to Skia milestone m153.
highlights_body: The update incorporates upstream correctness fixes. Linux applications that rely on fontconfig fallback should verify their text rendering after upgrading.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback can select a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, which can change selected glyphs or text metrics. Specify an explicit family and style, or bundle the typeface, when deterministic font selection is required.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled rendering engine to the Chrome m153 line, including its upstream correctness fixes.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 opened the 4.153 line with the Skia m153 engine update and its upstream correctness fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2: Release Candidate 1 validates the 4.153 line following Preview 1.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.300 scopes compiler conversion-warning suppressions to its native build, avoiding Windows binary-analysis warnings.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m153 engine update.
v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.body: It incorporates upstream renderer correctness fixes for the new release line.

v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Release Candidate 1 validates the m153-based release line.
